title: Generation of Human Elongating Multi-Lineage Organized (EMLO) Gastruloids
protocol: Dilute Matrigel 1:100 in ice-cold DMEM/F-12.
Add 1 ml of diluted Matrigel per well to pre-chilled tissue culture-treated plates and incubate at 37°C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO₂ for 1.5-2 h prior to passaging.
Bring mTeSR Plus medium to room temperature without using a water bath.
Passage the stem cells with GCDR: aspirate the cell culture medium, add 1 ml of GCDR to the well(s) to be passaged.
Incubate cells in GCDR for 3 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the Matrigel-DMEM/F12 solution from the coated 6-well plate using a 5 ml serological pipette.
Add 1 ml of room temperature mTeSR Plus medium to each well.
At the end of the GCDR incubation, aspirate the reagent and add 3 ml of mTeSR Plus to the well that is being passaged.
Use a 5 ml serological pipette to gently dislodge the treated colonies by performing a forward/backward scraping motion over the entire area of the well.
Rotate the plate 90 degrees and repeat the scraping motion to ensure all cells are dislodged from the substrate.
Pipette the suspension up and down 2-3 times before transferring 0.5 ml to each well of the 6-well plate already containing 1 ml/well using a P-1000 blue tip.
Return the coated plates with cell suspensions to the incubator and incubate overnight allowing colonies to adhere.
Visually inspect cultures for small colony adherence the next day.
Aspirate the 1.5 ml mTeSR from adherent colonies, rinse twice in 1 ml DMEM/F-12 to remove non-adherent debris.
Add 2 ml of fresh room temperature mTeSR Plus to each well.
Maintain the culture with fresh media changes when necessary until cultures reach approximately 50-60% confluency.
When cultures reach ~50-60% confluency, aspirate mTeSR Plus medium and rinse twice with DMEM/F-12.
Add 2 ml of N2B27 medium containing 3 μM CHIR 99021 and 40 ng/mL FGF2 per well.
Return the plates to the incubator and repeat this step 24 hours later after visual inspection.
Monitor the colonies for rounding-off as transcriptional programs transition away from pluripotency maintenance.
Ensure that FOXA2 expression is not lost by immunofluorescence (IF) staining.
Observe a loss of well-demarcated hPSCs within the colony into a more "blended" appearance.
Proceed to dissociate and transition to orbital shaking culture between 48 hours after induction when colonies show raised perimeters and cells migrating away from borders.
Prepare 10 (or 20 ml) N2B27 freshly supplemented with 10 ng/ml FGF2, 2 ng/ml HGF, 2 ng/ml IGF-1, and 50 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Warm the freshly prepared medium to room temperature.
Dilute Accutase 1:1 in HBSS (CM-free) for enzymatic dissociation.
Warm the diluted Accutase to room temperature.
Pre-treat tissue culture-treated 6-well plates with Anti-Adherence Rinse Solution for 10 min.
Aspirate the rinsing solution after pretreatment and rinse twice with 2 ml HBSS.
Rinse the cells two times in DPBS or HBSS.
Add 1 ml Accutase diluted 1:1 in the HBSS CM-free to the wells.
Return the wells to the incubator for 5 min.
Aspirate the enzyme solution after 5 min if the cells remain adherent.
Add 1 ml N2B27 basal medium (no supplements) per well.

If cells detach during the 5 min incubation time with Accutase, add 1 ml of culture medium and perform a centrifugation step in 2 ml tubes at 350 x g for 5 min to remove the enzyme and collect the cells.
Using a P-1000 blue tip, pipette gently to generate a single cell suspension.
Combine the wells and add the entire volume to a 15 ml conical tube.
Centrifuge at 350 x g for 5 min.
Aspirate the N2B27 basal medium from the cell pellet.
Dilute in the appropriate volume of N2B27 supplemented with the ROCK inhibitor, FGF2/HGF/IGF-1 to include 2 x 10^6 cells per well in 2 ml medium (1 x 10^6 cells/ml).
Place the plates on an orbital shaker set to the clockwise direction.
Validate aggregation by visual inspection using a microscope.
Fix a subset of aggregates 24 hours after transitioning to orbital shaker.
Stain fixed aggregates with DAPI.
Count cells from imaging data using confocal microscope-generated Z-stacks.
Determine the concentration of aggregates from a subset of the population by hemocytometer.
Dissociate aggregates to single cells.
Count single cells again with hemocytometer or an automated cell counting system.
Divide the total number of cells by the number of aggregates used to determine an average value at this stage.
Perform one-half volume media changes.
Prepare freshly supplemented N2B27 medium.
Replace one-half volume of medium with fresh N2B27 without ROCK inhibitor.
Pool aggregates in a 15 ml conical tube and allow them to settle by gravity.
Aspirate the settled media.
Add fresh medium to the aggregates.
Return the aggregates to low adhesion wells.
Visually inspect shaking cultures on day 2.
Aspirate the entire volume of media on day 3.
Replace with fresh N2B27 containing 2 ng/ml HGF and 2 ng/ml IGF-1.
Maintain cultures on the orbital shaker overnight to day 4.
Visually inspect cultures at day 4.
Replace the entire volume with fresh N2B27 basal medium only.
Transfer aggregates from a single well 1:1 to pre-treated 100 mm dishes using Anti-Adherence Rinsing Solution and 2x HBSS rinses.
Dilute one well of the 6-well plate to a final volume of 7-8 ml N2B27 in the pre-treated 100 mm dish.
Reduce speed on orbital shaker to 70 rpm.
Maintain developing EMLOs under reduced speed conditions.
Replenish EMLO culture media using a 15 or 50 ml conical tube with N2B27 basal every 3 to 5 days.
